in_sanskrit.name: सुधन्सु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has abundant good fortune, the one who has all the prosperity.

in_hindi.name: सुधन्सु
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who has control over good things, one who has good governance.

in_tamil.name: சுதந்சு
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who grows, the one who increases.

in_telugu.name: శుదహశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is abundant with good things, the one who is full of prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Sudhansu
